items.title: Reflection AI's Beam now available on AI Gateway for free
items.author: Jerilyn Zheng
items.summary: Beam from Reflection AI , previously available in stealth as stealth/cat-jam , is now available on AI Gateway . Beam is free to use for a limited time during the launch period when serviced by Reflection AI. Beam is an low latency US open-weight reasoning model for coding and agentic tasks, with weights released under Apache 2.0 . Beam supports tool calling and structured outputs , with a 1M-token context window for code, documents, and conversation history. Reasoning effort is adjustable. Beam is designed for speed, activating only 23B of its 501B parameters per token and avoiding tokens a task doesn't need, so it tends to reach answers sooner than larger open models. There are 2 ways to access Beam for free: Using the standard model name ( reflection/beam with provider reflection ). When the free period ends, the model slug will automatically transfer over to pricing with no downtime. Using the -free suffix to the standard name ( reflection/beam-free ). The model will stop serving when the free offer ends. To use it in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more, install the latest Vercel CLI and run setup: Then select reflection/beam or reflection/beam-free in the agent. See the coding agents guide for details. Try Beam in the model playground . AI Gateway provides a unified API for calling models, tracking usage and cost, and configuring retries, failover, and performance optimizations for higher-than-provider uptime. It includes built-in custom reporting , Zero Data Retention support , budgets for API keys , routing rules , and more. AI Gateway reflects provider pricing with no markup and does not charge a platform fee on inference, including on Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) requests. Read more
